caso.texto:
A team has an old name-and-phone list with no documented purpose. One contact requests no further outreach and access to their data. A seller exports it to a personal account and adds health information from a conversation. No commercial use is authorised.

An Indian scenario requires checking DPDP provisions and commencement, applicable telecom requirements and channel policy. Do not use a published rule as proof that every requirement has the same effective date.

projeto.instrucoes: Classify five risks, specify immediate action and owner for each and draft an initial response without inventing legal conclusions or deadlines.
projeto.gabarito: Pause list use pending purpose/procedure review. Record the stop preference, route access request, contain sharing and engage privacy/security owners. Do not exploit health data. Acknowledge the request without claiming deletion already occurred.

avaliacao_basica.observacao: Não substitui banco profissional de 40 questões / Does not replace a 40-question professional bank

simulacao.instrucao_ator: Play the fictional buyer. Reveal supplied facts when asked; say you need to verify unknowns. Do not teach or score during dialogue. After three turns raise a timing or scope concern; in a second round request closure.
simulacao.instrucao_avaliador: Use only the transcript and rubric. Cite evidence, identify gaps and request human review for uncertain scores. Do not issue certificates or approve contracts.
